Messages.Author: Serge Salazar
Messages.Body:
"No vote pushing. Each Methuselah is allowed to play one political action
card for a vote per vote, including the card used to call the vote, if any."

I apologize for this post but I can already hear the arguments from the
group I play with.
If MethuselahA calls a vote w/ a card, MethuselahA cannot add any further
votes by using a card. All other Methuselahs may play only one political
action card, if they have it, for the current vote.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <H8S_6.1903$y7.5...@news1.rdc1.ne.home.com>, Serge Salazar
<serge...@home.com> writes

>I apologize for this post but I can already hear the arguments from the
>group I play with.
>If MethuselahA calls a vote w/ a card, MethuselahA cannot add any further
>votes by using a card. All other Methuselahs may play only one political
>action card, if they have it, for the current vote.

If I call a vote with a poltical action card - say, Kine Resources
Contested - that card counts as my source of votes re: vote pushing.
Everyone else can still play one from their hand.

If I call a vote with, say, the referendum clause on Elysium (which
isn't a political action card), I can play one from my hand, as can
everyone else.

Essentially, at any point, work out how many votes you are getting from
political action cards. If it's zero, you can play one (as in the
Elysium version). If it's one, you can't (as in the KRC version).

Messages.Author: Mari
Messages.Body:
"Serge Salazar" wrote:
> If MethuselahA calls a vote w/ a card, MethuselahA cannot add any further
> votes by using a card. All other Methuselahs may play only one political
> action card, if they have it, for the current vote.

Actually, you can't gain anymore votes with a Political Action card...
You can still use Bewitching Oration, Awe, Business Pressure, etc. You
may not replace any of those cards as they are played until the end of
the referendum, though. Reacting vampires can use Dread Gaze, Suprise
Influence, etc and they also may not replace any of those until the
end of the referendum.

Just thought I would clarify, though it may have been a little obvious
to some...
